title: Structured dataset documentation: a datasheet for CheXpert

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the representational composition of the dataset by calculating the distribution of patients across different MeSH age groups to identify potential disparities, specifically noting the severe underrepresentation of pediatric patients (infants and adolescents).
Analyzing the dataset's demographic composition by calculating the distribution of patients and images by biological sex to assess representational balance and potential data imbalances.
